data.overview: Dr Pierre Ricaud is a French dermocosmetics brand founded in 1986, owned by Groupe Rocher since 2007, that manufactures anti-aging skincare in its own factories in France and sells directly to consumers without intermediaries. Available evidence focuses on the brand's own sustainability and made-in-France commitments (recycled packaging, refills, the 3R policy) plus a third-party CSR analysis rating its environmental communications at a B. No independent safety, cruelty-free, or labour-ethics assessment specific to the brand was found in the fetched sources.

claims.claim: The brand says its recycled plastic and glass packaging saved 84 tonnes of virgin glass and 21 tonnes of virgin plastic in 2023.
claims.quote: In 2023, thanks to the integration of recycled plastic and glass in our packaging, we saved 84 tons of virgin glass and 21 tons of virgin plastic.

claims.claim: The brand states all its products are made in France and Europe and distributed directly without intermediaries.
claims.quote: We are a French brand, all of whose products are made in France and Europe and have chosen to ditribute our products without an intermediary

papers.title: Analyse RSE Dr Pierre Ricaud
papers.summary: This third-party CSR analysis rates Dr Pierre Ricaud with a global score of B, noting it communicates more completely than most peers on major CSR issues. It highlights circular-economy initiatives such as ecological refills that saved tonnes of glass and plastic, progressive removal of plastic films, recyclable/compostable packaging, responsible sourcing of lotus polyphenols from India, and use of vitamin C synthesized from natural glucose.

findings.text: The brand receives a global CSR score of B and is judged to communicate more completely than most peers on major CSR issues.
findings.quote: Avec un score global B , Dr Pierre Ricaud communique de manière plus complète que la majorité de ses pairs sur les enjeux RSE majeurs.

findings.text: Its ecological refills for the 'Essence de Beauté' range saved over 15 tonnes of glass and 3 tonnes of plastic in 2020.
findings.quote: En 2020, plus de 90 000 recharges ont été vendues, économisant ainsi plus de 15 tonnes de verre et 3 tonnes de plastique.

findings.text: The analysis credits responsible sourcing of lotus polyphenols harvested in India via ecological extraction processes.
findings.quote: Dr Pierre Ricaud agit dans ce domaine en assurant la provenance responsable des polyphénols de lotus, récoltés en Inde et extraits via des procédés écologiques.

papers.title: Dr. Pierre Ricaud Reviews: AI Score and Reviews from 50,000 Beautydecoders
papers.summary: An independent physician-led analysis of 25 Dr Pierre Ricaud products across its main ranges, drawing on 87 user reviews. It praises the transparency of documented active ingredients (niacinamide, AHA, multi-weight hyaluronic acid, peptides) and the organic galanga innovation, while cautioning that several users report perfume in the formulas, a potential issue for hyper-reactive skin. It confirms the brand joined Groupe Rocher in 2007.

findings.text: The reviewer praises transparency of documented active ingredients with proven efficacy across the range.
findings.quote: The transparency of the active ingredients: niacinamide, AHA, multi-weight HA, peptides - documented active ingredients with proven efficacy.

findings.text: Several users report perfume in the formulas, flagged as a potential problem for hyper-reactive skin.
findings.quote: A word of caution: several users report perfume in the formulas, a potential hindrance for hyper-reactive skin.

findings.text: The source confirms the brand joined Groupe Rocher in 2007.
findings.quote: The brand joins the Groupe Rocher in 2007 .
